achievements.name: Opening Chapter
achievements.detail: Finish the first chapter of any traveler's story.

achievements.name: Full Story
achievements.detail: Complete every chapter of a single traveler's tale.

achievements.name: Eight Travelers
achievements.detail: Recruit all eight travelers into your party.

achievements.name: Break and Boost
achievements.detail: Break an enemy by emptying its shields, then spend Boost points on an action in that battle.

achievements.name: Day and Night
achievements.detail: Change the time of day while you are in town.

achievements.name: Path Action
achievements.detail: Use a traveler's path action on a person in town.

achievements.name: Crossed Path
achievements.detail: Finish a Crossed Path shared by a pair of travelers.

achievements.name: Side Story
achievements.detail: Complete a side story you picked up in town.

achievements.name: Set Sail
achievements.detail: Take the ship from one continent of Solistia to the other.

achievements.name: Secondary Job
achievements.detail: Have a traveler learn a secondary job at a guild.

achievements.name: Latent Power
achievements.detail: Unleash a traveler's Latent Power during battle.

achievements.name: All Stories
achievements.detail: Finish the last chapter of all eight travelers.

achievements.name: Extra Tale
achievements.detail: Complete the further story that unlocks once every traveler has finished their own tale.
